notes: Hugging Face dataset Lichess/chess-puzzles at revision 461725966ea46898ec6481372a6326de3281bfbd, shard data/train-00000-of-00003.parquet (one of three), read with pyarrow. Kept: Popularity >= 80, NbPlays >= 200, Rating 700-2600, >= 4 legal moves, one puzzle per game, four rating bands of a quarter each, mate-in-one <= 18 % per band, longest-option cue capped at chance + 0.10 on questions with <= 26 options. Gold = the puzzle's first solver move (Moves[1]) in SAN after pushing Moves[0]; options = all legal moves. Group key = Lichess game id (GameId before '/' or '#'); the shard has GameId instead of GameUrl.
